## Problem and change

What user-visible problem does this solve? Link the issue if there is one.

## Evidence

List commands and actual outcomes, plus the exercised UI/CLI path when behavior changes. Note anything not verified.

For physics changes, cite the method/data, describe prediction changes, and preserve holdout blindness. For project-format changes, describe migration and round-trip behavior.

## Checks

- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior or invariants, not implementation wording.
- [ ] User-facing docs/changelog updated where applicable; accuracy claims match evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, private coordinates, or unlicensed third-party flight files included.
